operative-toughness-passive.head: 3561fb210fd3bf6e3513e3e60cf06895d778c840
operative-toughness-passive.scope: Removing the loaded passive removed both ballistic and melee resistance bonus rows. Reload restored them with separate Combat Toughness +7% contributions in each row.

operative-improved-invisibility-passive.head: 3561fb210fd3bf6e3513e3e60cf06895d778c840
operative-improved-invisibility-passive.scope: Unload and reload changed the ballistic and melee defense bonus totals by 10 each and removed and restored the Improved Invisibility +10-point Determination contribution.

operative-master-assassin-upgrade.head: 3561fb210fd3bf6e3513e3e60cf06895d778c840
operative-master-assassin-upgrade.scope: Stock activation showed attributed caster bonuses of Stealth +8, Thrown Accuracy +7 and Thrown Damage +10. The visibility and reveal contest still needs evidence.
